name: Obsession Unleashed
source:
Its a bright new day, New adventure to explore!

Will it be an AMAZING day?

Or just a boring old day, trying to find an adventure?

Keep hoping, your CHOICE your FATE.

But as you keep making different choices, you realise something is NOT right here...

Maybe [s]HE[/s] has to do something with it?

Maybe HE [s]M4d3[/s] this [s]W0r1d[/s] just for you.

It's weird... It was the first time you met someone with a [s]FACE[/s]

Was it really your first time though?

[s]The world doesnt feel real..[/s]

But you're way too use to it.. So JUST [s]I[/s]G[s]N[/s]ORE IT!!<3

[From [url=https://verp0q.itch.io/obsession-unleashed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
又是阳光明媚的崭新一天，新的冒险正等待你去探索！

今天会是精彩绝伦的一天吗？

还是说只是努力寻找冒险却依旧无聊透顶的寻常一日？

继续怀抱希望吧，你的选择决定你的命运。

然而随着你一次次做出不同的选择，你渐渐察觉到这里的一切很不对劲……

或许这和[s]他[/s]脱不了干系？

或许是他专为你[s]创Z40[/s]了这个[s]世J13[/s]。

真奇怪……这明明是你第一次见到长着[s]五官[/s]的人。

可这真的是你的第一次吗？

[s]这个世界总让人觉得不真实……[/s]

但你早已习以为常了……所以只管[s]无[/s]视[s]它[/s]就好啦！！<3
